evidence: Touches Guix release build scripts, manifests, and verification checks in contrib/guix/ under the 'Build system' label.
rationale: Compiling Linux release binaries as -static-pie substantially expands platform portability across Linux distributions. According to the release notes and discussion, this enables release binaries to run on non-glibc environments like Alpine, distributions without standard FHS paths like NixOS, and systems with older glibc installations, while unblocking security hardening like aarch64 pointer authentication (#19075).
